name: Stale cache invalidation after document update

chat_messages.text: The document update banner still says stale cache. Should the browser refresh?

The support ticket label is stale cache invalidation after document update, but its only requested change is refreshing a preview badge when the browser regains focus. It does not cover invalidating stored cache entries.
A parser update changed a document preview. Which version label should appear?
Show the parser version alongside the preview; the fixture does not describe cache eviction after a document write.
How should a synthetic cache entry expire after an idle period?
Expire entries after a fixed idle timeout. There is no document update or write event in this case.

name: Recover a corrupted archive from backup

chat_messages.text: Can we preview a damaged archive before deciding whether a backup is needed?
List readable fixture entries in a temporary preview. This is a diagnostic view, not the restore procedure.
Where should the example backup archive be uploaded for a support rehearsal?
Use the synthetic support drop folder. This conversation covers upload logistics, not recovering the local archive.
How do I tell whether the test backup itself is corrupted?
Compare its checksum with the fixture manifest. Do not use this note as a restore plan.
Why did the sample offset pagination page number change?
The example inserts a row before page two, so the offset moves. This is a failure demonstration, not the stable cursor design.
How should the page buttons look while records are loading?
Disable the next button during loading. This is about the pager interface, not stable result ordering.
How do we sort a static fixture table before printing it?
Sort the frozen rows by label. The data never changes during this export, so no pagination cursor is involved.
Jak znaleźć dwa pliki JSON o tej samej nazwie po pobraniu archiwum?
Porównaj nazwy plików w katalogu pobierania. To porządkowanie plików, nie deduplikacja konwersacji w indeksie.
Dlaczego lista rozmów pokazuje dwa podobne tytuły?
Dwa różne wątki mogą mieć taki sam tytuł. Nie łącz ich tylko z powodu nazwy; ten przykład dotyczy widoku listy.
Jak usunąć kopie załącznika po imporcie?
Porównaj skróty plików załączników i usuń zbędne kopie binarne. Konwersacje pozostają oddzielne.
Should a failed test model download retry automatically after HTTP 503?
Retry with exponential backoff. This fixture does not describe resuming from a verified byte offset.
What should the progress bar show when a model download pauses?
Keep the last percentage visible with a paused label. This is only a user-interface state.
Can a synthetic model upload resume after an interrupted connection?
The upload fixture uses server-assigned parts. It says nothing about downloading a local model.
Why was the model download interrupted at the sign-in page?
The fictional catalog requires a fresh test token. This note diagnoses authorization, not how to resume transferred bytes.
The model download stopped when the example disk filled up. What should be checked?
Check free disk space in the synthetic destination. There is no range-request recovery procedure here.
Where is the resume control shown after pausing a test model download?
The button appears beside the progress bar. This is a layout note, not a resumable transfer implementation.
Should parser-map.v2.yaml appear in the example changelog?
Yes, list parser-map.v2.yaml as a changed fixture. The changelog does not explain which file controls the parser.
Should we keep a copy of parser-map.v2.yaml before editing?
Keep parser-map.v2.yaml.bak in the synthetic workspace. This covers backup naming, not the parser mapping source.
What color should the E_SYNC_7421 status badge use?
Use the fixture warning color. This does not explain the sync cursor failure.
Where does the fake worker print E_SYNC_7421?
It prints E_SYNC_7421 in the local fixture log. For the error meaning, consult the sync cursor note.
Where are the imaginary v2.17.4-rc7 release notes displayed?
Show v2.17.4-rc7 in the sample release list. This does not cover the checkpoint migration.
